text: 1.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.
